content: Reflections on starting a personal website, choosing Hugo, and what I hope to share through this space.
title: Starting Something New: Why I Built This Website

content: The Beginning of a Digital Home Starting this website feels like opening a new chapter in my developer journey. For a while, I’ve been wanting a space that truly represents my growth, projects, and the things I’m learning along the way—more than what a typical social media profile can capture.
title: Starting Something New: Why I Built This Website

content: Why Hugo? I chose Hugo as the foundation for this site after exploring several options. Here’s why it stood out: ⚡ Blazing Fast: As a static site generator, Hugo creates incredibly fast-loading pages 🛠️ Developer-Friendly: Written in Go, with a straightforward structure and great documentation 🎨 Flexible Theming: The LoveIt theme provided a beautiful starting point that I could customize 📝 Markdown Simplicity: Writing content in Markdown feels natural and efficient The process of setting up Hugo reminded me why I love web development—there’s something satisfying about seeing your vision come to life through code.
title: Starting Something New: Why I Built This Website

content: What to Expect Here This isn’t going to be a formal blog with rigid structures. Think of it more as: A learning journal where I document technical challenges and solutions A project showcase for my experiments and serious work alike A thinking space for ideas about technology and development A progress tracker for my journey from junior to (hopefully) senior developer I believe in learning in public and sharing the process, not just the polished results.
title: Starting Something New: Why I Built This Website

content: The Tech Behind This Site For the curious, here’s what powers this website: Platform: Hugo Static Site Generator Theme: LoveIt (heavily customized) Deployment: Vercel Styling: Custom CSS + Theme defaults Content: Markdown with Hugo shortcodes
title: Starting Something New: Why I Built This Website
